classesPageIntro: We currently run classes twice per week at 1606 Fisher Ave, on Mondays and Wednesdays. Monthly fees are $80 for regular classes (8 per month, plus occasional events and supplementary irregular classes), open to everyone aged 16+.

The intake program is a set of two 1.5-hour long classes that take place on the first Monday and Wednesday of each month. The program is designed to introduce students to the foundational skills of our curriculum. After completing the intake program, students are welcome to join our regular classes, which are divided into three levels: Fundamentals, Intermediate, and Advanced. Each level builds upon the previous one, allowing students to deepen their understanding and proficiency in the art.

Wrestling, dagger and sword in one hand are the foundation of our curriculum and inform everything that we do, regardless of the weapon(s) in hand. The beginner classes will focus on developing proficiency in these three skills, and as students progress, they will be introduced to more complex actions, tactics, and additional weapons:
classesPageIntroList: Sword in one hand along with its secondaries: dagger, cloak, buckler/targa, rotella, second sword
Polearms: partisan, spear, bill, pike, pollaxe, halberd, glaive

scholars.name: Scholar test - Max (Ottawa)
scholars.description: The Ottawa Chapter of the Academy of European Medieval Martial Arts welcomes its third Scholar into its ranks. Max successfully passed their scholar test in front of 4 Scholars, 1 Free Scholar, and 1 Provost. Their test covered the Art of Fiore dei Liberi and that of the Bolognese tradition, primarily from Dal'Agocchie's manuscript. They demonstrated their knowledge of theory, their execution of the principles and plays, and free fenced with arming swords to the satisfaction of all present.
